body: China Airlines said it will launch its first New Year themed flight, with an Airbus A321neo operating the designated Taipei–Bangkok flight CI837 on December 31, allowing passengers to welcome 2027 in the air. Sales open at 10:00 on November 5 through the airline's website and app.

Passengers on the themed flight will receive a NT$1,000 Uber credit for airport transfers, an elephant key ring from the Tourism Authority of Thailand, a limited-edition New Year blind-box bear co-branded with Aroma Teddy, a free three-day unlimited-data KLOOK eSIM, onboard celebrations and a New Year certificate, plus a draw for China Airlines miles, a Pikachu-liveried CI2 model aircraft and other merchandise. For dining, all cabins can choose barbecue from the 大腕燒肉 restaurant, while economy class also gets a Thai-style grilled chicken leg rice, along with desserts and drinks designed for the themed flight.

On arrival in Bangkok, passengers will receive a free Bangkok BTS transit card and ChaTraMue Thai tea, and can enjoy Divana SPA at a discounted price; stays at 華航好哩宿 partner hotels can be partly offset with miles.
en.summary: China Airlines will operate its first New Year themed flight, with an Airbus A321neo flying Taipei–Bangkok flight CI837 on December 31 so passengers can welcome 2027 in the air; sales open at 10:00 on November 5, with ride credits, a co-branded blind-box bear, a free eSIM and a New Year certificate among the perks.
en.title: China Airlines launches first Bangkok New Year themed flight, with A321neo flying CI837 into 2027

body: 中華航空今天表示，首度推出「高空跨年泰有意思」跨年主題航班，以A321neo執飛台北—曼谷指定航班CI837，旅客可以在12月31日搭乘該航班，在空中迎接2027年。航班將於5日上午10時起，在華航網站及App正式開賣。
華航指出，搭乘跨年主題航班的旅客可享有Uber千元折抵送機優惠、泰國觀光局大象鑰匙圈、Aroma Teddy聯名限定新年小熊盲盒、KLOOK eSIM免費3日不限流量吃到飽、空中慶祝活動及專屬跨年證書，還有機會抽中華航哩程、皮卡丘彩繪機CI2模型機及周邊商品。機上餐點方面，全艙等提供燒肉專門店「大腕燒肉」供旅客選擇，經濟艙另推出融入泰式風情的南洋烤雞腿排飯，並有專為跨年主題航班設計的甜點和飲品。
旅客抵達曼谷後，可免費獲得曼谷BTS交通卡、泰國手標茶ChaTraMue，並以優惠價體驗Divana SPA；入住「華航好哩宿」合作指定飯店，還可使用哩程優惠折抵房費。
zh.summary: 中華航空首度推出跨年主題航班，以A321neo執飛12月31日台北—曼谷CI837，旅客可在高空中迎接2027年；航班將11月5日上午10時起開賣，搭乘旅客可享接送折抵、聯名小熊盲盒、免費eSIM與跨年證書等優惠。
zh.title: 華航首推飛曼谷跨年主題航班，A321neo執飛CI837高空迎新年
